I went to school for a few years so I can read what is on the fertilizer bag, but I still trust what I see with my own eyes and what my neighbors do. Last season I used my FISP coupon to get two bags of NPK and two bags of urea for this plot, and because I own this land I also worked in manure from my goats and chickens. This season I will do the same — I will plant hybrid maize seed because that is what the agro-dealer had and my neighbor’s crop was good with it, but I will not waste money on chemicals for weeds when my family can hoe, and I have no irrigation. My children and I will spend about 100 days working this field from planting to harvest, and when the weeding is heavy I will hire young people from the village for about 12 days because my back is not what it used to be.
